name: axitl
description: Syntax highlighting, completion and hover help for the .axitl timeline language.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Checking runs axitime, a program found in the workspace, so files are only checked in a trusted workspace.

axitl.check.enabled.markdownDescription: Check `.axitl` files with `axitime check` when they are opened and saved, and show its errors and warnings.

axitl.check.command.markdownDescription: The command that runs axitime, one word per item, e.g. `["/Users/me/AxiTimeline/.venv/bin/axitime"]`. When empty, the `axitime` in the nearest `.venv` folder at or above the file is used, else `axitime` on the PATH. That's quicker than `uv run`, which checks the environment is up to date before every run.
